reviews.title: Not a bad case
reviews.comment: Pretty nice case, but the downside is the accessibility to open it up along with the vents for the gpu display ports. I had to cut out the vent using wire cutters, which is strange, but I guess it’s fine since most PCs only have one GPU. The panels have screws too so I kept them off to have more accessibility. They do pop in thought which keeps them from falling.
reviews.author: HaitrieuN

reviews.title: Solid Case
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] Solid Case all around, only reason it’s not a 5 star is that removing the PCIE brackets is incredibly unintuitive for a case at this price point
reviews.author: Isaiah

reviews.title: Great case with lots of room
reviews.comment: Really great bang for your buck. Beautiful visuals, lots of room for large graphics cards, up to atx motherboards, and had no trouble fitting a 360mm aio. Works great, One thing that really s nice for me, is quick access to the back so I can easily swap out satas quickly. Just pops right off. Also great with cable management.
reviews.author: ThomasP

reviews.title: Great aesthetic case
reviews.comment: Great white case. Has all your needs. Very aesthetically pleasing. Thermaltake case are the most beautiful! Could use another USB and usb-c on the front panel but that is very minor.
reviews.author: KennethD

reviews.title: Very good mid range case for white builds
reviews.comment: Great case, cable management is easy, looks amazing. Good price for a dual chamber case like this, only nitpick is the back pcie slots are breakaway
reviews.author: MichaelF
